decisions.decision: Keep T-335 as the single Adi input for Live Control, with the ask unchanged (SDK app credentials plus the 5 poll scopes in one Zoom sign-in). Ignore the 2026-10-11T23:43 ripple note asking to strip the poll scopes: O-695a03c5 folded them in because no Zoom-signed-in browser was available. Do not create the Zoom app yourself. Meanwhile keep everything else moving on T-226: seat build scripts ready to pull ZoomSDK.framework into cloud/seat/Frameworks, run sheets saved, probe-live-control green. Each run, read https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/api/zoom/control with centre_admin.py. Once the Seat credentials card reads saved and all 5 poll scopes read present, mark T-335 done, build the seat app and run the T-226 test meeting. If a Zoom-signed-in browser turns up first, add the 5 scopes yourself and shrink the ask to the credentials only.
decisions.why: ~/.config/tantra holds only zoom-bot-key, no Meeting SDK Client ID or Secret. T-226 and T-407 (2026-10-11) confirm zoom_sdk_enc absent in production. Creating a Zoom app credential needs Adi's sign-in to an outside service.
